title: Privacy and your data
summary: What KloudC keeps, where it lives, and where to read the privacy policy.

items: Each store's data is kept in its own separate database, apart from every other store.
Passwords are stored scrambled (hashed). Nobody, including KloudC, can read them.
Connection keys (POS, WhatsApp, email, AI) are encrypted and never shown again after saving.
Returning customers keeps only a scrambled code of each card, never a card number or a name.
Ask Inventory Bot and the weekly digest send the question and the report figures they need to the AI service. Nothing else.

blocks.text: Read the full [privacy policy](https://kloudc.com/kloudc-privacy-policy/) on kloudc.com. Questions? Email {support_email}.
**About**: KloudC RetailOps is made by KloudC LLC, Connecticut, USA. The app's version is under More › About.
